ns2:course.label: Biomedical Imaging
ns2:course.description: Physics and engineering principles associated with x-ray, computed tomography, nuclear, ultrasound, magnetic resonance, and optical imaging, including human visualization and perception of image data. Same as BIOE 380. Prerequisite: MATH 285 or MATH 286.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Same as BIOE 380. Prerequisite: MATH 285 or MATH 286.
